Fastest: Ancient spellbook > Annakarl Teleport (Demonic Ruins).
Alternatively: Ctrl+T > Slayer > Level 99+ > Abyssal Beasts, step into the obelisk just north of the landing > 5. More > 2. Level 50, run west to the middle of the scan area.
Third option: Ctrl+T > Skilling > Agility > 52 - Wilderness Course, run east to the middle of the scan area.
Final step: Run north-west to the middle of the deep-Wilderness scan area, then start scanning.
Clue: Scan the area and dig at the spot the scan map narrows down to.

Fastest: Fairy ring DLQ (north Kharidian Desert) (portable fairy ring required to be the fastest).
Alternatively: Ctrl+T > Locations > Dominion Tower, run south-east to the middle of the scan area, staying east of the River Elid.
Third option: Traveller's necklace > Desert Eagle's Eyrie, run south to the middle of the scan area.
Final step: Run north to the middle of the scan area, then start scanning.
Clue: Scan the area and dig at the spot the scan map narrows down to.
Tip: make a portable fairy ring in ;;ig, or buy an unlimited one for 5 Kavros dollars.
